# Edna Iusupova

> Engineer working on the evaluation of AI-generated code, kernel optimisation and
> benchmarking. Based in the Paris region, France. Site: https://ednaiu.github.io/

## Who

Edna Iusupova is an engineer based in the Paris region, France. She is enrolled in the
M2 Distributed and Parallel Computing (DiPaC) programme at Universite Paris-Saclay for
2026 to 2027, after the M1 Quantum and Distributed Computer Science programme at the same
university, and holds a BSc in Software Engineering (Neurotechnologies and Programming)
from ITMO University in Saint Petersburg. She completed the Gray Scott School 2026, a
56-hour European HPC summer school on programming and optimisation for heterogeneous
architectures, organised by LAPP and CC-FR under the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking.

She has four years of professional experience across four companies while studying,
currently designing AI workflows and tooling for an e-commerce back office engineering
group: MCP servers connecting issue tracking, wiki, GitLab, SAP and test management,
agent skills, and controlled trials that decide which approaches a team adopts.

## Research interests

- Evaluation of AI-generated code: where model-written code loses to a tuned reference,
  by how much, and what that implies for review.
- Autotuning and performance modelling: Bayesian optimisation, gradient descent and
  simulated annealing over tiling, blocking and threading parameters.
- Empirical study of AI agents in the engineering process.

## Selected work

- TrustGate, a merge gate scoring Python against the defect profile of generated code.
  Benchmarked on 245 samples against bandit, semgrep, ruff and flake8: 0.854 recall on
  the generative-defect slice against 0.341 for the next best tool, precision 1.000, zero
  false positives across 74 clean samples. https://github.com/ednaiu/TrustGate
- AI-Driven BLAS Library, a master's research project graded 19/20, supervised by Oguz
  Kaya. AVX2 microkernels with FMA, cache tiling, OpenMP threading and autotuned search,
  measured against OpenBLAS on a 20-core workstation.
  https://github.com/ednaiu/2526-m1qdcs-terhpc
- Cloud GPU Compiler, a published VS Code extension compiling and running CUDA on remote
  GPUs through the Compiler Explorer API.
  https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=EdnaIusupova.cuda-cloud-compiler
- Flood Map Prediction, a preprocessing pipeline harmonising ERA5 climate series with 13
  static environmental layers and satellite flood labels.
  https://github.com/ednaiu/Flood-Prediction-Starting-Kit

## Skills

Python, PyTorch, C, C++, CUDA, SQL, TypeScript, Bash. Hugging Face Transformers,
scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas, Docker, MCP, OpenMP, MPI, AVX2 intrinsics, CMake, Git,
GitLab, Linux, Kafka, REST, Jira, Confluence, SAP. Benchmarking and profiling,
autotuning, Bayesian optimisation, experiment design, BPMN, UML.
